name: usage-meter
description: A machine-wide meter of the plan's rolling 5-hour usage: every session's turns summed as effective tokens, the cap learned from each session-limit hit, the burn on the status line, a toast before the wall, /usage and a usage_status tool so Claude can pace itself. No process runs, no model calls.

windowHours.title: Window (hours)
windowHours.description: How far back the rolling window reaches: the plan's session limit meters 5 hours.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often every session's turns are summed again, the status line redrawn and summary.json rewritten when the figures changed.

warnAt.title: Warn at (% of the last limit)
warnAt.description: Toast once when the window's effective tokens first cross this share of the cap estimate; armed again once the share falls back below it.
